title.zh: Morning Minute: Crypto Rebounds After The Fed’s First Hike Since 2023
title.en: Morning Minute: Crypto Rebounds After The Fed’s First Hike Since 2023

current_state.zh: Crypto majors rebounded with BTC at $76.4k after the Fed delivered its first 25bps rate hike since 2023, while the House advanced the U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve bill and Circle's Arc chain saw over $400M in debut volume.
current_state.en: Crypto majors rebounded with BTC at $76.4k after the Fed delivered its first 25bps rate hike since 2023, while the House advanced the U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve bill and Circle's Arc chain saw over $400M in debut volume.
